name: app.mochify/mochify
title: Mochify
description: Privacy-first image and PDF processing. Compress and convert between JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and JPEG XL, resize, smart-crop, rotate, adjust brightness and clarity, remove backgrounds, and preserve or generate Ultra HDR gain maps. PDF toolkit: shrink a PDF while its text stays searchable, extract embedded images, rasterize pages, split it, or build one from images. Files are encoded in RAM and originals are never stored.
